fixture_sign.purpose: Sign / EncodeEnvelope: creates operational signed fixture; signature admission is not under assertion

qualification_limits: testStore directly starts upstream NATS server and nats.Connect over loopback TCP with FileStorage; no natscell in-process clients. No cluster/quorum/failover/crash-durability/deployment/runtime receipt inferred.
epochFence is synthetic authority. Pause wrappers delegate actual JetStream; chosen purge/read faults are injected. The incomplete-inventory watcher is wholly synthetic and retains unit scope.
Local decision mappings do not record a journal. Observation/health/action assertions use synthetic Records, Events, supplied timestamps and Health values; no executor or serving process is run.
historyReadKV pre-I/O deadline checks and cancel-before guards retain local scope separately from real store readback. Actual inventory/read/write/CAS effects are credited only to asserted targets.

Operational trust fixture signing is incidental to inventory classification; no cryptographic admission/execution qualification. No source/repository/ledger/runtime/count/deletion/retirement/completion mutation or credit. Independent peer review required.
